item.title: Globex partners with Snowflake to launch Globex Connect
item.description: Globex Data announced a strategic partnership with Snowflake and launched Globex Connect, a native connector that brings Globex governance to Snowflake workloads.

item.title: Why data governance matters in 2026
item.description: Governance is becoming a board-level topic. Here is how Globex helps.
